name: 83835 · Hayden, ID
findings: ZIP 83835 (Hayden) has 96 nonprofit organizations. 38 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 83835 (Hayden) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 83835 (Hayden) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
